About Us

 

The OllieTree Foundation is a dedicated non-profit organization 501(c)(3) founded and registered in Charlotte, North Carolina, in 2018. Our mission is to enhance the well-being of our community through education, health advocacy, and compassionate care.

Our Focus Areas:

  • Promoting Health and Wellness: We strive to make medical and health knowledge accessible to all, empowering individuals to lead healthier lives through information and resources.
  • Advocating Healthy Lifestyles: By promoting wellness practices and healthy living, we aim to prevent disease and improve overall quality of life.
  • Supporting Educational Ministries: We believe that education is a powerful tool for change. Our programs are designed to educate and inspire individuals across various age groups and backgrounds.
  • Providing Community Medical Consultation: Our outreach includes offering medical consultations to those in need, ensuring that everyone has access to essential health services.
  • Caring for the Elderly: We are committed to improving the quality of life for our senior community members through dedicated care and support.

At The OllieTree Foundation, our goal is to assist the underserved and vulnerable populations in our community by leveraging medical expertise and educational resources. We are driven by a passion for making a positive impact and fostering a healthier, more informed society.

Join us in our mission to create lasting change and build a stronger, healthier community for all.

OllieTree Foundation


Gather Love, Convey Love,
Share Love, Witness Love

Who We Are

Established in March 2018, OllieTree Foundation is a non-profit organization 501(c)(3) based in Charlotte, North Carolina. The foundation networks medical and healthcare professionals locally, regionally and globally, to serve the communities in need through free consultation and health clinics. The foundation has the missions to promote healthy lifestyle, provide senior care and youth development through various educational programs and community outreaches.

What We Do

Youth Volunteering, Summer Tutoring, Sunday Study Group, Youth leadership development. Run by high school volunteers

Annual OllieTree Free Health Clinics, Medical Newsletter, Healthcare seminars and workshops

OllieTree 5K Run or Walk Annual Event, OllieTree Running Clubs, Overseas left-behind children and family support

Senior visitation, community outreach and retirement medicaid consultation. Bringing joy and relaxation into their day

What‘s New

Volunteer Sign-up for the OllieTree Foundation Sunday Study Sessions is now open!

Click Here to Enroll 2026-2027 Group Study 

Congratulations to our graduating senior class! Thank you for time in the OllieTree Foundation!

OllieTree Living

Supporting Our Elders

Our Mission

The OllieTree Foundation strives to support Chinese and other Asian immigrant elders to create a foster a more meaningful and inclusive society.  We help socially connect their lives through culturally familiar environments and services. For elders in Charlotte area and beyond, the OllieTree Foundation brings families closer!

Our Vision

The OllieTree Foundation envisions a thriving, inclusive community that bridges generations, reduces isolation, and enhances the well-being of Asian elders abroad. OllieTree is building a “Sweet Home” for our elders. The foundation strives to create that caring and tight-knit community available for all. 

 

Core Services

Cultural Activity Centers

Tai Chi, Chinese calligraphy, music, traditional holidays

Digital Hub

Mandarin/Cantonese-language app for event registration, social groups, and family connectivity.

Language & Integration Support

ESL classes, translation assistance, civic education.

Health & Wellness

Nutrition workshops, medical consultation, mental health support in Mandarin/Cantonese, wellness check-ins.

Past Clinics

Our Mission

At OllieTree, our mission is to break down barriers to health and wellness by making essential medical care and knowledge accessible to everyone, regardless of their circumstances. We are committed to creating equitable access to healthcare through free community clinics, empowering individuals with the information and resources needed to lead healthier lives.

We strive to advocate for healthy lifestyles, provide compassionate care to underserved populations, and ensure no one is left behind—particularly vulnerable groups such as the elderly and those facing financial or systemic challenges. By prioritizing accessibility and inclusivity, we aim to bridge gaps in healthcare delivery and empower communities to thrive.

Together, we envision a world where quality healthcare is not a privilege but a fundamental right, fostering stronger, healthier, and more informed communities.

Sunday Tutoring Group (Free) for k-5+ Students in Charlotte Area

Register for the Sunday Tutoring Group

What We Offer

Personalized Tutoring

We are flexible and adapt to your needs to grow and excel through curriculum. Whether you are in kindergarten or upper elementary school, we are here to help!

Dedicated Support

Through our carefully-planned lessons interactive lessons, and engaged tutors, we help children excel and thrive in school. We offer small group tutoring in Math and English Language Arts (Reading and Writing) for students from K – 5+.

We learn your goals and work hard to help you achieve them. Our highly-competent tutors have their full-on dedicated support for you to reach your goals!

Sunday Study Group

Sunday Study Group is a small group format tutoring, help student a better achievement for school study. Hold biweekly on Sunday at Providence Presbyterian Church in Charlotte.

Our Leaders
Study Group
Opportunities

Our Mission

For more than five years, we have been supporting the theme of helping others- by promoting the physical, mental, and spiritual prosperity of the Chinese-American community.

Our projects focus on helping others and focusing on the theme of education.

We serve the community through our various health fairs and fundraisers, aimed at the underprivileged, the ill, and the elderly with our team of volunteers, specialists, and resources.

We help children excel in school through carefully planned tutoring lessons with handpicked tutors that fit their needs, offered throughout the summer.

As high schoolers, we are not professionals, doctors, pastors, or coaches, however, we deeply value spreading joy and happiness as well as education for a better future, which is why we have embarked on such programs and events described above.

Our Youth Volunteers have been an essential part of in supporting the welfare of the Chinese-American Community in North Carolina.

Update of Pandemic Outbreak in Charlotte, NC

What We Are Doing

We hold regular medical seminars to popularize medical and health knowledge for free
We care for the elderly and cancer patients in the community, providing care, resources, consultation, and help


We help left-behind children in remote mountain area build libraries and computer rooms


We organize and coordinate medical teams to conduct free consultations and medical assistance for communities in remote and poor mountain areas.


The OllieTree Foundation established the Health Consultation Public Account to provide Chinese people with correct , reliable, advanced, and practical health information

Read More

What We Are Doing

Establish a high quality, skillful, full spectrum of professionals in the OllieTree medical team to regularly provide free medical services and medical assistance to communities and poor areas;

Establish all direction assistance for left-behind children in mountain areas to maintain healthy daily, physical, psychological, and spiritual life, starting from one household, one village, and one town

Establish a Christ centered OllieTree ministry team to spread the love of Christ and the gospel with love, care, and service

Collaborate and cooperate with churches, Christian ministry, evangelical organizations, and caring social groups and work hard toward the Great Commission
Read More

Advantages of OllieTree Foundation

Professional Medical Personnel

Our professional medical team has gone through many years of learning and practice. Most are still working on the front line of the medical field. They are our most solid intermediate force and the most valuable wealth

Pure Goal

We uphold the principles of collaborativeness, openness, and transparency. The OlliTree Foundation is a non-profit organization. It is our goal to honor God and benefit others from the very beginning. We also take into account short-term effects and long term planning

Start with Our Feet on the Ground

Our co-workers stay close to life and feel the needs of the community. We actively provide our help, professional knowledge, and materials to the communities in the U.S. and the most remote mountain areas in China in a timely-assistant manner.

The Love and Zeal of the OllieTree Foundation to All

Some of Our

Recent Projects

Adopt cute little piggy banks to help little kids far away. Your loving heart is a child’s hope. Today’s seedling will become a towering pillar tomorrow. Let every left behind child feel the warmth from us.

2019年Charlotte社区义诊

由橄榄树基金主办、华助中心协办的夏洛特华人社区义诊2019 取得圆满成功。荣耀归于神！感谢各位用祷告、奉献、参与、关注等不同方式鼓励支持我们。这次义诊总共约有80多人参加服务（医务人员30多、工作人员20、义工22、Novant Health 体检团队10）。受益人士约150-160人次接受医疗咨询、其中有150人接受注册服务、70人次接受查血体检、50人次接种流感疫苗、42人次接受心电图检查。另外现场专门有中文翻译为大家就医提供方便。社区内外对此次义诊有良好评价。夏洛特华人社区义诊将每年举办一次，同时也期待您继续支持。

 此次活动也得到当地媒体的报导和关注。

Privacy Policy

Information Collected and Stored Automatically
When you visit the Our web sites, if you do nothing during your visit but browse through the web site, read pages, or download information, we will gather and store certain information about your visit automatically. This information does not identify you personally. We automatically collect and store only the following aggregated general information about your visit:

the pages you visit,
the date and time you access our site,
the name of the domain from which you access the Internet (for example, aol.com, if you are coming from an America Online account, or bju.edu if you are connecting from Bob Jones University’s domain),
the Internet address of the website from which you linked directly to our site, and
your operating system and browser.

We use this information:

to measure the number of visitors to the various sections of our site,
to help us make our site more useful
to develop and code content pages so that most people will be able to view the pages correctly.

If You Send Us Personal Information
If you choose to provide us with personal information, as in an e-mail message or by filling out a form, we store the question and e-mail address information just long enough to answer the question that was sent in, and send the answer back to the e-mail or other address or phone number provided. If you send us a comment, we relay the comment to the most appropriate staff member. If enough questions or comments come in that are the same, the question may be added to one of our help or FAQ pages, or the suggestions may be used to guide the design of our Web site. Unless otherwise required by statute, we do not identify publicly who sends questions or comments into our web site.
Children under 13 years of age are not encouraged or invited to contact us via our webs sites.

e-News updates by e-mail
If you subscribe to our e-News, we consider your e-mail address confidential and it will not be released.

Disclosure
BBN does not disclose, give, sell or transfer any personal information about our visitors, unless required for law enforcement or by statute.

Disclaimer of Endorsement & Links to Other Sites
Our web site has links to many other web sites. If you access another site through a link we provide, you are subject to the privacy policy of the new site. Reference in this web site to any specific ministry, commercial products, process, service, manufacturer, or company does not constitute its endorsement or recommendation by us. we are not responsible for the contents of any ‘OFF-SITE’ web pages referenced from this server.

Intrusion Detection
For site security purposes and to ensure that this service remains available to all users, we employ software programs to monitor traffic and identify unauthorized attempts to upload or change information, or otherwise cause damage. In the event of authorized law enforcement investigations, and pursuant to any required legal process, information from these sources may be used to help identify an individual.
